reuse.why: Takes its categories from the shared getMonthWideTargetCategories and reads spending from the existing sum-amount sheet cells, with the same mutator/undoable registration as the other actions; the income-in-tracking rule is still written out at the site, as every sibling does.

duplication.why: Adds one more copy of the per-site `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` guard and an inline sign flip like setNMonthAvg's, instead of folding them into the shared selection.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts beside them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and its tests.

maintainability.why: Follows the existing pattern closely and is easy to own, though the income rule is now repeated in six actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; category selection goes through getMonthWideTargetCategories

disguised_duplication.where: the income guard is a plain copy of the sibling actions' guard
